name: Inclusense Accessibility Widget
author: inclusense

sections.description:
Inclusense adds an accessibility widget to your WordPress site so visitors can adjust it to suit how they read and browse. Text size, contrast, spacing, a screen reader, a reading guide and more, all from one small button.

You can start on the Free plan. No credit card, no time limit. Upgrade later if you want more tools, more languages or your own branding.

Inclusense also scans your pages for WCAG issues, shows you exactly where each problem is, and suggests code fixes. The widget helps visitors right away, and the scans help you fix the underlying problems on your site.

Learn more about the WordPress accessibility widget.

Accessibility widget: 16 tools

  • Screen reader (text-to-speech)
  • Text size
  • Line height
  • Letter and word spacing
  • Contrast
  • Brightness
  • Saturation
  • Magnifier
  • Big cursor
  • Reading guide
  • Highlight links
  • Highlight on hover
  • Bionic reading
  • Pause animations
  • Hide images
  • Page structure (headings, links and landmarks)

Scan, audit and fix

  • Scan your pages against WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 from your Inclusense dashboard
  • See screenshots that show where each issue appears on the page
  • Get AI fix suggestions with example code for each issue
  • Re-scan after fixing to check your progress
  • Try the free website accessibility checker

Built to support accessibility laws

  • WCAG 2.1 and 2.2
  • ADA Title III (United States)
  • European Accessibility Act (EAA) and EN 301 549
  • Section 508
  • AODA (Ontario)

An accessibility widget on its own does not make a website compliant. Inclusense gives your visitors tools straight away, and the scans and audits help you find and fix the issues in your site’s code.

Customisation and languages

  • Custom widget icon, colours and position
  • Custom triggers: open the widget from any button or link on your site
  • Show or hide individual tools
  • Multiple languages with a visitor language selector
  • Set a default language, or detect the visitor’s language automatically
  • Remove Inclusense branding and add your own logo

Analytics

  • See how visitors use the widget
  • Visitor activity and browsers
  • Where your visitors are, by country

For agencies

Manage many client websites from one dashboard. Agency plans include more scan pages, more AI fix credits and multi-project support.

Free and paid plans

The plugin is free. The widget is managed from your Inclusense account, which has a free plan and paid plans.

Free plan: $0, no time limit

  • 6 core tools: text size, line height, contrast, highlight links, reading guide and pause animations
  • Up to 10,000 page views a month
  • No credit card needed

Paid plans: from $19 a month

  • Up to 16 tools
  • More page views (up to 1 million and more)
  • Multiple languages and automatic language detection
  • Full widget customisation and custom triggers
  • Remove Inclusense branding and add your own logo
  • Email and priority support

Accessibility scans

  • Free: 20 pages a month with a quick audit preview
  • Paid plans add more pages, AI fix credits and batch scanning

See all plans at inclusense.eu/pricing.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide accessibility features.

Inclusense Widget Service

Purpose: loads and manages the Inclusense accessibility widget on your website.

Script loaded: https://embed.inclusense.eu/script.js

How it works:

  • The plugin loads the Inclusense widget script on the front end of your site.
  • The widget connects to the Inclusense API and checks that your domain is registered.
  • Your widget settings are loaded from your Inclusense dashboard.
  • Domains that are not registered cannot load the widget.
  • Widget usage data (such as which tools are used, browser and country) is collected for your analytics dashboard.

Terms and privacy policy: https://inclusense.eu/privacy-policy

Google Translate

Used to translate the widget and page content when a visitor chooses another language.

Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Create a free account at inclusense.eu.
  3. Add your website in the Inclusense dashboard.
  4. Choose your widget settings and save.

The widget will appear on your website automatically. You do not need to edit any code.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is free, and Inclusense has a free plan with 6 core accessibility tools for sites with up to 10,000 page views a month. No credit card is needed. Paid plans add more tools, languages and customisation.

Will this make my website ADA or EAA compliant?

No widget can make a website fully compliant on its own. Inclusense helps in two ways: the widget gives visitors tools to adjust your site right away, and the accessibility scans find WCAG issues in your site’s code so you can fix them. Fixing those issues is what brings your site closer to WCAG 2.2, ADA and EAA requirements.

Do I need to edit my website code?

No. Install and activate the plugin, then manage everything from your Inclusense dashboard.

Can I customise the widget?

Yes. On paid plans you can change the icon, colours and position, add custom triggers, choose which tools to show, set languages and remove Inclusense branding.

How do accessibility scans work?

Add your website in the Inclusense dashboard and start a scan. Inclusense checks your pages against WCAG 2.1 and 2.2, lists each issue by severity, shows where it appears and suggests how to fix it.

I manage client websites. Can I use one account?

Yes. You can add several websites to one account, and agency plans are built for managing many client sites.

Does the widget slow down my website?

No. The script loads in the footer and does not block your page from loading.

Which languages does the widget support?

The widget supports many languages. Paid plans include a visitor language selector, a default language setting and automatic language detection.
